FN-6WOKZZ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 3
Committee: Health Sponsor: Representative Debbie Wood
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/15/2023
House Bill 3 as introduced would increase the administrative and financial obligations of the
Alabama Department of Public Health (ADPH) by a small, undetermined amount to create a
stand-alone page on ADPH's website explaining the health care facility visitation requirements
established by this bill.
